mapper.select: select u.id as user_id, u.create_time as user_create_time, u.update_time as user_update_time, u.is_disabled as user_is_disabled, u.is_published as user_is_published, u.avatar as user_avatar, u.email as user_email, u.gender as user_gender, u.id_card as user_id_card, u.nickname as user_nickname, u.phone as user_phone, u.real_name as user_real_name, r.id as role_id, r.is_disabled as role_is_disabled, r.name as role_name, r.code as role_code from `user` u left join user_role_list ur on ur.user_entity_id = u.id left join role r on r.id = ur.role_list_id where u.id = #{id}

select distinct p.id, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.is_disabled, p.is_published, p.identity, p.name, p.parent_id, p.type, p.is_system from role r join role_permission_list rp on rp.role_entity_id = r.id join permission p on p.id = rp.permission_list_id where r.id = #{roleId} and coalesce(r.is_disabled, 0) = 0 and coalesce(p.is_disabled, 0) = 0 order by p.id asc
select p.identity from permission p where coalesce(p.is_disabled, 0) = 0 order by p.id asc

select p.identity from user_role_list ur join role r on r.id = ur.role_list_id join role_permission_list rp on rp.role_entity_id = r.id join permission p on p.id = rp.permission_list_id where ur.user_entity_id = #{userId} and coalesce(r.is_disabled, 0) = 0 and coalesce(p.is_disabled, 0) = 0 group by p.id, p.identity order by p.id asc

select m.id, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.is_disabled, m.is_published, m.name, m.parent_id, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.order_no from menu m where coalesce(m.is_disabled, 0) = 0 order by m.order_no asc, m.id asc

select distinct m.id, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.is_disabled, m.is_published, m.name, m.parent_id, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.order_no from user_role_list ur join role r on r.id = ur.role_list_id join role_menu_list rm on rm.role_entity_id = r.id join menu m on m.id = rm.menu_list_id where ur.user_entity_id = #{userId} and coalesce(r.is_disabled, 0) = 0 and coalesce(m.is_disabled, 0) = 0 order by m.order_no asc, m.id asc
